notes: 0.1.15 with a custom openai-compatible provider (no Xiaomi login): OpenCode lineage with the user-agent rebranded to 'mimocode/<version> ai-sdk/provider-utils/<v> runtime/bun/<v>' and x-session-affinity on the main requests; the system prompt starts 'You are MiMoCode, an interactive CLI tool…' (Claude Code-style text), 15 tools including actor, memory, history, cron and skill_search. A title side request with a StructuredOutput tool and two system messages precedes the first turn (covered by the extra identity prefixes). Identical on the first turn, after the tool call and on the --continue follow-up. With the built-in openai provider id it switches to a Codex-style harness ('You are Codex…' prompt, one exec tool, /v1/responses, an un-rebranded 'originator: opencode'); that variant is not captured and is denied here by the originator header.
